== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Vehicle Mine (Japanese)|Vehicle Mine]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157878146/_gRu6dbbgUahpUe-jjm3sQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 157878146.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>e84c0c056d77769a5efe3f95f90c65a9a7337aac02a3107217922f0ed2edaa02</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
